@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: b480
+title: 'Adopt EditorKit ^d5f8cwa: selection and focus paint the theme accent (34 focus-ring and selection-fill tests fail on EditorKit past 14abdc9)'
+---
+EditorKit main past 14abdc9 (a0fa294, three ^d5f8cwa commits) changes how selection and focus draw: "selection and focus paint the theme accent". It also adds a shared accent fixture and a focus-ring bed in EditorTestSupport. On that EditorKit, 34 AVK tests fail, all in focus-ring masks and selection fills: AgentItemFocusRingHostedTests, AttachmentFocusRingHostedTests and SelectionSurfaceSitesHostedTests. `focusRingMaskBounds` is zero, and the fill pixels don't match. Until this card lands, every AVK tree pins EditorKit at 14abdc9 locally (Package.resolved is gitignored).
+
+## Work
+- [ ] Read EditorKit ^d5f8cwa and its style.md change: how the accent now paints the selection and the focus, and what the shared accent fixture and focus-ring bed are for.
+- [ ] Bump EditorKit to its main.
+- [ ] Update AVK's selection-surface and focus-ring code to the new rule, with accent only for selection and focus. Keep ThemeInjectionTests' accent allow list consistent with it.
+- [ ] Rewrite the three suites onto EditorKit's shared accent fixture and focus-ring bed (generic helpers live in EditorKit). Delete AVK's own copies of those probes.
+- [ ] Re-record any snapshot whose pixels change, light and dark only.
+- [ ] `swift test` is green on EditorKit main.
\ No newline at end of file
